claim_boundary: One RP2350 board, ten official p324_3 keys copied into one fixed-address buffer, an XIP-cache invalidation immediately before each timed operation, one fixed public message, one fixed signing RNG stream, two deterministic randomized schedules, and five samples per key per schedule.  This bounded screen can expose repeatable key-associated wall-clock time on this target; it is not a physical leakage test, a control/address trace, an attack, a worst-case timing claim, or evidence of side-channel resistance.

baseline.predeclared_screen_rule: Spearman >= 0.8 for the two per-key median rankings; in both passes, between-key span >= 1% of the central median and >= 10x the median within-key MAD

d1.predeclared_screen_rule: Spearman >= 0.8 for the two per-key median rankings; in both passes, between-key span >= 1% of the central median and >= 10x the median within-key MAD
